# NEA Precision Skin

> Physician-managed skin and wellness clinic in NE Calgary, Alberta. "Healthy skin starts inside." NEA combines Fotona laser, medical-grade skincare (ZO Skin Health, AlumierMD, Vivier, Glo, Luzern) and injectables with gut, skin and vaginal microbiome testing (BioAro Labs) and Registered Dietitian nutrition led by founder Raman Kapoor, RD.

- Address: #104, 3151 27 Street NE, Calgary, Alberta
- Phone: 1-403-230-8812 · Text: 403-973-0722 · Email: nea@neaskincare.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; Sunday closed
- Booking: https://neamedicalaesthetic.janeapp.com/
- Free 15-minute consultations and a complimentary Skin Health Report (advanced facial scan)

## Programs
- [Clear Skin Program](/programs/clear-skin): adult and hormonal acne, rosacea, acne scars
- [Even Tone Program](/programs/even-tone): pigmentation and melasma, including medium and deep skin tones
- [Hair Regrowth Program](/programs/hair-regrowth): PRP + Fotona laser hair restoration with nutrition and hormone insight
- [Healthy Aging Program](/programs/healthy-aging): Fotona 4D, injectables, DEXA, truSculpt flex, inflammation markers
